title: Fareva in France and Chromavis in Italy join forces in high-end skincare
summary: Fareva and Chromavis are combining their scientific, formulation and creative expertise to develop new skincare concepts, bringing together advanced skin science and Italian creativity. The collaboration within the Fareva group aims to leverage Chromavis' expertise in product design, innovative textures and sensorial experiences with Fareva's formulation and skincare development capabilities in France.
